prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in League City, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported neck and back strain. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1346; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the intersection in League City, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a vehicle operated by Driver 1 and a vehicle operated by Driver 2. Driver 2 was traveling straight through the intersection when Driver 1 was turning left and failed to yield the right of way. The front of Driver 2's vehicle struck the left side of Driver 1's vehicle. Both vehicles sustained visible front-end and side damage and were not drivable without towing. A Passenger was riding in Driver 2's vehicle and was not injured. Driver 1 reported pain in the neck and lower back and stated that the pain began shortly after the impact. Driver 1 was evaluated on scene by emergency medical services and declined transport at that time. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Driver 1 was issued a citation for failure to yield the right of way while turning left. No further action was taken at the scene.
